small.label: 24 GB GPU (RTX 4090 class)
small.notes: Fits a ~27B model at Q4 (~18 GB) with ~32k context. Cheapest; fastest per dollar for one user.

medium.label: 48 GB GPU (L40S / RTX 6000 Ada / A6000)
medium.notes: Room for 64k+ context (agents like Claude Code want this) or Q8 quantization of a ~27B model.

large.label: 80 GB GPU (H100)
large.notes: Fastest tokens/sec, 128k context, or several models / ~70B models at Q4.
